pool.baseline: it's just the sheer inefficiency of it all. i spend every single day performing a version of myself that doesn't actually exist just to minimize the friction with other people. it's like trying to run a complex program on hardware that's completely incompatible. the constant error logs, the overhead of masking... it's not even about being sad anymore. it's just that the cost of maintenance is higher than any possible output. eventually, the only way to stop the system from crashing is to just... shut it down entirely. it feels like the only logical conclusion to the equation.
